name: Shared Pulse
rule_excerpt:
**Shared Pulse** (`tend.shared_pulse`). Renamed: **Overflow** is a shelved advanced move (`classes.json`, an Outburst
gauge). *"Your Mend on a Bonded ally also sends {=numbers.share|pct}% of it down every Bond you hold, the Mend's own
target included."*
- Fields: `share: 0.25`. Why: with three Bonds, the target gets 125% and the two others 25%: three quarters of a Mend
  more for the price of one. Worded so the target is included because `selectUnits` has no "not the event's target"
  (only `redirect` drops it, in code); the cheaper wording beats a `targets.not` field.
- Carrier: a second `mend` row on Mend's action, `targets {side: ally, tied: bond}`, the amount at `share` (copied, not
  split: no new op field). The brake (below) counts only the Mend's own target as a Tending received.
- Mender: Rally (once a scene, every Bonded ally) stays the big one. Peak: no (no damage is shared).
- Excite: the Ward on the Bulwark breaks, you Mend it, and the two others on your threads tick up too.

No gray, shading, gradients, glow, texture, opaque black paint, text, numerals, frame or border. All gaps, including screen dark areas, must be transparent. Center the whole compact action in a generous 15% transparent margin, square 1024x1024 composition. Readable at 32/44px (condition signs also at24/48px). CAST: exactly the approved Wick, the small CERAMIC AUTOMATON with oversized chamfered rectangular head, inset 8-BIT PIXEL-SCREEN expression, small ear discs and offset fasteners, chunky mitten hands/boots, short ASYMMETRIC CAPELET, and visible round LANTERN HEART with thick equal cross arms. About 2.4 heads tall, no human face, no literal flame-head. ONE full Wick maximum; others are cropped partials. Keep cape wedge and heart readable. The cup/bowl and floating arrows in Mind Without Fog belong ONLY to that trait, NOT this icon. No default cup, saucer, head halo, reference corner star or decorative arrows. 
PAINT: Wick presses one careful mitten to a cropped ally forearm, while the same healing pulse branches through TWO broad threads to two other cropped hands. Three matching simple pulse rings, one per receiver; a warm concentrated face.
AVOID: No full squad figures, lightning attack, blood, tiny busy thread mesh or unequal star clutter.
